question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM for the underlined word in the given sentence.

Her profile was __complete__ on the company website.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "Incomplete".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Complete"** means something that is finished, entire, or having all the necessary parts; it signifies something that is whole or finalized. (पूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example:** The painting is complete and ready for exhibition.
 
 
 
• **"Incomplete"** refers to something that is unfinished, lacking certain parts, or not whole. It is the direct antonym of "complete." (अपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example:** The assignment was incomplete, and the teacher asked him to finish it before submission.
 
 
 
• Hence, the opposite of **"Complete"** is **"Incomplete".**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Uploaded** (अपलोड किया गया): The act of transferring data or files to a server or website.

 
 
• **Example:** She uploaded the documents to the company portal.
 
 
 
• **Created** (निर्मित): To bring something into existence or produce something new.
 
 
• **Example:** He created a beautiful sculpture from clay.
 
 
 
• **Received** (प्राप्त किया गया): To be given or accepted something, such as a message or item.
 
 
• **Example:** She received an award for her outstanding performance.
